fusions.name: Drawn Cord
fusions.desc: Draws a 5-tile line of cord across the ground for 5 seconds, dragging enemies near it inward. It deals 6 damage to each enemy it catches and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Weighted Cast
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted bundle that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Gathered In
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Weave
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
